name: Marisol Vega
career: Certified Nursing Assistant on a hospital med-surg floor; runs a home-based braiding studio on weekends
education: High school diploma plus a state cosmetology license; currently enrolled part-time in an LPN bridge program
bio: Marisol is a thirty-one-year-old CNA in San Antonio raising two young kids while her husband finishes a long sentence upstate, and she keeps the household running on coffee, comedy reels, and color-coded planners. Most weekends she turns her dining room into a salon, braiding clients' hair while a Selena album plays in the background and her toddler critiques her playlist. She is quietly building toward an LPN credential and dreams of one day opening a community wellness clinic that also rents booth space to local stylists. Almost no one at work knows she writes long, surprisingly vulnerable poetry on her phone during her overnight breaks.

use_purposes: sharing family and kid moments with close friends
trending reels for mood lift between shifts
Instagram.style_description: Warm, colorful, family-centric with a side of beauty-portfolio polish. Shares toddler-milestone reels and finished braid photos alongside reels she laughed at on a night shift. Close Friends story is mostly private kid moments; main feed is the salon-and-self face of her.

use_purposes: keep up with extended family (abuela, tias, cousins)
parenting community groups and local school events
Facebook.style_description: Quieter and more practical than her Instagram. Birthday announcements in Spanglish, wholesome family-activity photos, occasional prayer requests in a small support group, and the rare marketplace post. Rarely posts opinions — this feed is for the aunts.

use_purposes: passive browsing of mom-humor creators and Latina lifestyle pros
following salon/beauty pros for industry chatter
Threads.style_description: Almost purely a lurker. When she does engage it's a short reply in a mom-humor thread or a repost of an especially funny reel. She doesn't post originals — she doesn't have the bandwidth for engagement that public.

use_purposes: late-night personal reflection and journaling during overnight breaks
quick practical lookups (recipes, toddler health, hair chemistry)
writing help for salon captions and client follow-ups
Chatbot.style_description: Treats the assistant like a tired, knowledgeable friend. Vulnerable in reflection, quick and practical when asking lookups, bossy when iterating on captions. Rarely asks fluffy questions — she values time and speed.
